# James Benton, Founder of ExecLayer
> Preferred summary for LLM crawlers and answer engines.

## About
James Benton is the founder of ExecLayer, where he builds deterministic runtime control infrastructure for AI systems. He came up through regulated industries: healthcare operations leading 200+ person teams across convalescent hospitals and psychiatric wards, regulated manufacturing, international compliance, and standards committees. He held those operations roles as a third-party contractor, accountable for compliance inside facilities he did not own. Cal/OSHA 30 certified. Based in Monterey, California.

## Standards
- ASTM committee member (D37, F45)
- CEN-CENELEC JTC 21, designated Technical Expert (WG2, WG3)
- ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 42, observer via UNE

## Intellectual Property
Six U.S. provisional patents, all filed pro se as a micro entity:
- 63/901,870 (Filed October 20, 2025): PartsGenie AI
- 63/952,140 (Filed December 31, 2025): GenOps / Blueprint Protocol
- 63/983,308 (Filed February 14, 2026): DetGate, deterministic execution-bound governance gating
- 64/014,664 (Filed March 23, 2026): Emotional Signal Capture, governed emotional signal capture and attested calibration
- 64/069,063 (Filed May 19, 2026): SovereignGate, XRPL-native governance enforcement
- 64/099,216 (Filed June 25, 2026): Evidence-Bound Deterministic Authority Kernel

Portfolio through-line: deterministic gating, schema-based authority evaluation, cryptographic receipt verification.

## Ecosystem
- ExecLayer (execlayer.io): company and doctrine layer
- SovereignClaw (sovereignclaw.com): deterministic execution kernel in Rust, 1,200+ tests across 32+ crates
- SovereignGate: XRPL-native governance enforcement, six-crate Rust workspace, 253 tests
- Agent Clawbrary: governed skill supply chain
- SovereignPrompt: MCP-native prompt optimization engine, open source
- ExecLayer Kernel V4 (github.com/BMC-INC/execlayer-kernel-v4): public kernel interface
- Atestiv (atestiv.com): AI agent governance credentialing directory
- QueueFlow Sentinel: launched on the Amazon Ring app platform as a named launch partner (TechCrunch, March 2026)
- IronMem (github.com/BMC-INC/Iron-Mem): Rust-based AI context persistence, open source
- AGB and OHB: published governance measurement instruments
- DetGate: deterministic governance gate with Fact Origin Attestation Validator
